GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Returns the events matched by the PIR's query, newest match first. Each item has the Event List event fields plus the match fields. Only datasets the account can read now are included, and deleted events are left out, so a page can hold fewer items than `per_page` while `result_info.cursor` is still set. `backfill` matches came from the 30 days before the PIR was activated or its query changed and are never notified. `delivered` matches were included in a digest that the notification service accepted; who receives it depends on the account's notification policies for the PIR. Requires the Threat Events entitlement.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.summary: Count a priority intelligence requirement's matched events
GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Counts the PIR's matches by tag, attacker, attacker country, target industry, primary indicator, or indicator type: the top values, the number of distinct values, and the matches without a value. Covers the same matches as the matches list, in datasets the account can read now. Tags are grouped case-insensitively and shown with their most common spelling; an event counts once for each of its tags. `indicator` is the first indicator each event was created with. Field values are copied when an event matches; matches still being copied are reported in `matches.pending` and not counted, and matches whose event was already gone when its fields were copied in `matches.missing`. Counts keep the copied values, so an event deleted later stays counted. Requires the Threat Events entitlement.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Returns the account's organization profile, which all of its Priority Intelligence Requirements share to judge how relevant intelligence is to the organization. `result` is null when the account has no profile.

Returns the managed topics a structured PIR can follow, with their default question, relevance criteria, suggested actors and event rules. Suggested actors the account cannot see are left out. Topics change centrally; PIRs follow a topic's defaults wherever the customer has not changed them. Also returns `organization_types` for the organization profile form.

organization_types.description: Shortcuts for the organization profile form, each suggesting `sectors` and `suggested_protected_targets` for the customer to confirm. A type is never saved; topics are recommended by the profile's confirmed sectors, matched against each topic's `recommended_sectors`.

profile_context.description: Inherited facts this topic emphasizes: listed as Highly relevant and available to its event rules. Every PIR inherits every fact.

question_template.description: English question; only `{targets}` and `{regions}` are substituted.

suggested_actors.description: Suggestions the account can see; others are left out.

PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-.summary: Triage a priority intelligence requirement's matched events
PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-.description: Sets `triage_state` (`new`, `relevant`, or `not_relevant`) on up to 100 matches. Matches that do not exist, or are in datasets the account can no longer read, are returned in `not_found`. Setting `new` clears `triaged_at` and `triaged_by`. Requires the Threat Events entitlement.

matches.description: Up to 100 matches to set the triage state on.

200.description: The matches that were updated and those not found

PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-.summary: Update an account interest for PIR Option 2
PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-.description: Updates a structured account interest used by Priority Intelligence Option 2 evaluations. Changing the value re-resolves the interest against the current catalog.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Creates a new PIR for the account. The cfone.priority_intelligence_requirement_limit entitlement sets how many PIRs can be active; drafts do not count, but the account can hold at most five times that many PIRs in total. A free-form PIR has a `requirement`, and an active one requires a query. A structured PIR has a `definition` instead; its requirement and event query are generated, and the response includes them in `resolved`.

based_on.description: `resolved.based_on` from the resolution the user reviewed. Required with `definition`; if the organization profile or topic has changed since, the save fails with 409 and must be resolved again.

dataset_scope.description: `default`: every event dataset the account can read: Cloudforce One intelligence, datasets shared with the account, and the account's own datasets, such as Threat Signals. `datasets`: explicit dataset IDs. Analytics datasets are not matched. An active PIR can cover at most 50 datasets. Access is rechecked whenever the PIR is matched.

definition.description: Structured PIR answers. `managed` follows a topic from `GET /topics`; `custom` has its own question and criteria. The requirement text and event query are generated from it.

digest_interval_hours.description: Hours between digests: 6, 12, or 24. Used only when `notification_mode` is `digest`.

notification_mode.description: `none` or `digest`. Notifications are opt-in. `immediate` is reserved and currently rejected.

branches.description: Event List `searchBranches`: filters within a branch are ANDed, branches are ORed.

version.description: Ignored. Accepted so a PIR read from the API can be sent back unchanged.

requirement.description: Free-form requirement. Required unless `definition` is sent.

status.description: `draft`: not monitored. `active`: monitored, unless `pause_reason` is set. Setting `active` on a PIR with a `pause_reason` resumes it. Moving a PIR back to `draft` and activating it again starts matching afresh with a 30-day backfill.

400.description: Invalid PIR, such as an active free-form PIR without a query, or a definition with an unknown topic or a problem that blocks saving

403.description: Account not entitled to create PIRs

429.description: Active PIR quota or total PIR limit exceeded

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.summary: Generate event filters from a PIR
POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Translates a natural-language Priority Intelligence Requirement into Threat Events `searchBranches` with Workers AI. Terms that cannot be expressed as event filters are returned in `unresolved_terms`. Nothing is stored or executed.

requirement.example: Track North Korean or Russian actors phishing banks in the United States

custom_feed_count.description: The current count of custom feeds for the account.

custom_feed_limit.description: The custom feed limit for the account.

custom_feed_count.description: The current count of custom feeds for the account.

custom_feed_limit.description: The custom feed limit for the account.

branches.description: Event List `searchBranches`: filters within a branch are ANDed, branches are ORed. Empty when coverage is `none`.

coverage.description: `full`: every term resolved. `partial`: some terms are unresolved. `none`: no filter could be generated.

intent.description: Structured intent extracted from the requirement, before catalog resolution.

model.description: Workers AI model used for intent extraction.

unresolved_terms.description: Requirement terms that could not be expressed as event filters.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.summary: Create an account interest for PIR Option 2
POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Creates a structured account interest used by Priority Intelligence Option 2 evaluations. Interests are evaluated independently from free-form PIR requirements.
Uses bounded full-span top-N candidates and daily event-date buckets. Results are conservative rather than an exact historical replay.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.summary: Evaluate recent event-dated changes for account interests
POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Compares the trailing event-date window with the preceding window. Results are precision-gated to enabled account interests. Late ingestion can cause an older event to appear in a later evaluation, so results describe changes in event-dated intelligence rather than exact adversary-activity timing.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.summary: Get PIR quota for an account
POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Returns the account's PIR quota. `quota` and `remaining` count active PIRs against the entitlement limit; moving a PIR to draft or deleting it frees its slot. `total_quota` and `total_remaining` count every PIR, drafts included, against five times the limit. Anniversary dates are informational.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.summary: Resolve structured PIR answers without saving
POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Returns the requirement and event query that saving `definition` would generate, using the account's current organization profile and topic. `resolved.issues` lists problems that would block saving, and `resolved.notices` inputs that would be ignored. Search events with `resolved.event_plan.branches`: a beta value for running searches, not a stable contract, which changes whenever a topic's event rules change. Show `resolved.event_plan.rules[].explanation` to explain matches. Send `resolved.based_on` with the save so it fails with 409 if the profile or topic changes in between. Nothing is saved, and no model is called.

definition.description: Structured PIR answers. `managed` follows a topic from `GET /topics`; `custom` has its own question and criteria. The requirement text and event query are generated from it.

200.description: The resolved PIR and what it was based on

400.description: Invalid definition, or an unknown topic

PUT /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Updates a Priority Intelligence Requirement for the authenticated account. Changing the query increments its version; editing the requirement without saving a query marks the query stale. Activating a draft needs a free slot in the active PIR quota; setting `active` on a PIR the matcher paused resumes it without one. Updates to a structured PIR must send its `revision` and change its answers through `definition`; its requirement, title and query are generated.

based_on.description: `resolved.based_on` from the resolution the user reviewed. Required with `definition`; if the organization profile or topic has changed since, the save fails with 409 and must be resolved again.

confirm_query.description: Write-only. `true` confirms the query still fits the requirement, clearing `query_stale` without changing the query or its version. Requires a query.

dataset_scope.description: `default`: every event dataset the account can read: Cloudforce One intelligence, datasets shared with the account, and the account's own datasets, such as Threat Signals. `datasets`: explicit dataset IDs. Analytics datasets are not matched. An active PIR can cover at most 50 datasets. Access is rechecked whenever the PIR is matched.

allOf.description: Structured PIR answers. `managed` follows a topic from `GET /topics`; `custom` has its own question and criteria. The requirement text and event query are generated from it.
Replaces a structured PIR's definition. Free-form PIRs cannot be converted yet.

digest_interval_hours.description: Hours between digests: 6, 12, or 24. Used only when `notification_mode` is `digest`.

notification_mode.description: `none` or `digest`. Notifications are opt-in. `immediate` is reserved and currently rejected.

branches.description: Event List `searchBranches`: filters within a branch are ANDed, branches are ORed.

version.description: Ignored. Accepted so a PIR read from the API can be sent back unchanged.

revision.description: The `revision` the change is based on. Required for structured PIRs; a different stored revision returns 409.

status.description: `draft`: not monitored. `active`: monitored, unless `pause_reason` is set. Setting `active` on a PIR with a `pause_reason` resumes it. Moving a PIR back to `draft` and activating it again starts matching afresh with a 30-day backfill.

400.description: Invalid update, such as activating a free-form PIR without a query, or a definition with a problem that blocks saving

403.description: Account not entitled to activate PIRs

409.description: PIR was modified concurrently, or `revision` is not the stored one

PUT /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.summary: Create or replace the organization profile
PUT /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-on.description: Creates or replaces the account's organization profile: who the organization is, such as its name, brands, domains, sector, regions, key systems and suppliers. All of the account's Priority Intelligence Requirements share it. An account has at most one profile, and it does not count against the PIR quota. Send structured `organization` facts, which structured PIRs inherit and from which the profile text is generated, or free `profile` text. `revision` must match the stored profile's, or 0 when there is none; it is required with `organization`. Free `profile` text cannot replace structured facts; delete the profile first to switch back.

organization.description: Structured organization facts. Structured PIRs inherit them, and the profile text is generated from them.

revision.description: The `revision` the change is based on; 0 when the account has no profile yet.

profile.description: Who the organization is: its name, brands, domains, sector, regions, key systems and suppliers. Shared by all of the account's PIRs to judge how relevant intelligence is to the organization.

revision.description: The `revision` the change is based on; 0 when the account has no profile yet.

400.description: Invalid profile, such as blank or longer than 4,000 characters

409.description: `revision` is not the stored profile's, a concurrent write won, or free text was sent for a structured profile
